description: Adds the three CNAME records that authenticate this domain for emails Channext sends on the domain owner's behalf (SPF and DKIM).
variableDescription: mailid is the number of the return-path label issued for this domain (1234 for em1234); sendgridhost is the account part of the CNAME targets issued for this domain (u1234567.wl123 for u1234567.wl123.sendgrid.net).
